children: Smurfit Westrock agreed to acquire the Chilean containerboard and corrugated business of Empresas for $420 million.
As part of the deal, Smurfit said Wednesday will get a paper machine located in Santiago, Chile, which produces about 250,000 tons per year.
The company can also integrate recycled paper into its operations in Argentina, Peru and Ecuador, while routing kraftliner from Brazil and North America into the acquired Chilean assets.
Smurfit plans to fund the transaction using its own liquid resources. The deal is expected to close in the first half of 2027.
